component.name: Player Converter
component.summary: Convert movies for an external media player and copy them to a drive

description.p: Player Converter makes movies playable on a media player that only understands 8-bit H.264 (level 4.1, up to 1080p30) with AAC audio, then copies them onto a removable drive.
It always makes the lightest change that works:

ul.li: Files that already play are copied as they are
H.264 that is only tagged above level 4.1 is relabelled without re-encoding
Dolby, DTS and other audio is converted to AAC
HEVC, 10-bit and other unsupported video is re-encoded to H.264

description.p: It shows how many movies will fit before you start, respects the FAT32 4 GB file limit, can use NVIDIA, Intel or VA-API hardware encoders, and ejects the drive when done.
